chunks: From him, from ʿAmr ibn ʿUthmān, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Mālik ibn Aʿyan, who said:
I asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about the woman in istiḥāḍah: how may her husband have intercourse with her?

He عليه السلام said: "He considers the days in which she used to menstruate, when her menstruation was regular, and he should not approach her during the number of those days in that month. He may have intercourse with her on the other days besides that, and he should not have intercourse with her until he instructs her and she performs ghusl; then he may have intercourse with her if he wishes."

key_terms.الْمُسْتَحَاضَةِ: a woman experiencing istiḥāḍah, irregular non-menstrual bleeding
key_terms.تَحِيضُ: to menstruate; referring to her known menstrual period
key_terms.فَلَا يَقْرَبُهَا: he should not approach her sexually

ai.seo_question: When may a husband have intercourse with a woman experiencing istiḥāḍah according to Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a woman experiencing istiḥāḍah and marital relations. It instructs that her established menstruation days are to be treated as menstrual days in which intercourse is avoided, while outside those days intercourse is permitted after ghusl.
